page.title: About expose.u
page.tagline: Creative documentation for work that deserves to last.
paragraphs: expose.u is a Berlin-based creative studio for art-first photography and film. We work with galleries, museums, cultural institutions, exhibition and experience studios, and creative agencies to create visual work with a clear purpose.

Every project starts with understanding the work, the audience and what the images need to do. Whether they support a gallery’s sales, an institution’s funding report or a studio’s next case study, we shape the production around the goal.

Our work brings together thoughtful creative direction, a careful eye for art and design, and reliable delivery. The result is more than a record of what happened: it is a set of considered assets that helps a project reach further and stay present after it ends.
page.location: Based in Berlin, we work across Germany and beyond.
page.teamIntro: A small team with a shared care for the work.
